statistical_unit: one independently generated tree per (size, seed); repeats are technical timing replicates summarized within tree (median) before inference (review D4)
aggregation: per tree: mean±SEM and median/IQR over technical repeats; per size: tree-level summaries; scaling regression fitted on tree-level medians
version_provenance: Benchmark executed at commit 501f7735c7b7 (2026-08-26) and labelled v1.1.1 when that release was made. Releases v1.1.2-v1.1.4 leave the measured route unchanged: _parser.py and _serializer.py are byte-identical to this commit, and the only changes to styler.py are additive (a new set_tip_label_colors() method, one new instance attribute, and keyword arguments handed to the optional raster appearance pass). The calls this suite times -- load_content(), export(), set_layout(), set_tip_labels(), set_appearance(), highlight_clade() and set_clade_color() -- therefore execute the same code as at 501f773, so these data remain valid for v1.1.4 and were not re-run. Out of scope: the per-tip [&!color=...] annotations that set_tip_label_colors() writes into the exported NEXUS, and the Pillow post-render appearance pass; no script here calls either, so neither cost is measured.
provenance_maintenance: Hand-maintained annotation: full_benchmark.py rewrites benchmark_meta.json from machine state only and does not emit these two keys, so re-verify and re-add them after any regeneration.
